description: This file defines a ScreenRecordService class in Swift that provides screen recording functionality using ReplayKit and AVFoundation. It supports capturing video and optionally audio from the screen, manages capture states, processes sample buffers, handles errors, and writes the output to a file. The class exposes a public asynchronous record method to start, stop, and finalize recording sessions, with internal methods for configuration, buffer handling, and writer management.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Provides screen recording functionality using ReplayKit, AVFoundation, and manages capture lifecycle, configuration, buffer processing, and error handling.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main public method to start, run, and stop screen recording asynchronously, returning the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a configuration object for recording, handling parameters such as screen index, duration, fps, and output path.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates a file URL for storing the recorded output, either from a provided path or a temporary directory.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Initiates the recording process by starting ReplayKit capture with a given configuration and recording queue.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a closure that processes sample buffers received from ReplayKit, handling video and audio samples accordingly.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes incoming video sample buffers, manages writer initialization, and appends samples to the video input.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Configures AVAssetWriter and inputs based on the sample buffer, preparing for writing to output file.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes incoming audio sample buffers, appending them to the audio input if recording audio.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Completes the capture process, finalizing the video and audio writing sessions.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Finalizes the AVAssetWriter, ensuring the output file is properly closed.
